notes: 3-4-3 consensus: Suzuki; Gabriel, Van Hecke, Konsa; Tavernier, Manzambi, Palmer, Rogers; Haaland, N.Jackson, Evanilson. Captain Haaland (near-unanimous; N.Jackson the main alternative). Joao Pedro universal sell (thigh, 'a few weeks' - Alonso). Disagreement: PL Scout says buy Gabriel now vs FFS hold until after GW10 (LIV away); GK split Suzuki vs Raya/Verbruggen; Igor Thiago (BRE pens) a Hub alternative to Evanilson. PL Scout Selection XI for 2026/27 GW9 still not published as of 29 Oct 05:40 UTC.
